page.overview:
What is Cleaver?

[https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cleaver Cleaver] is a weapon found in the Slaughterhouse stage in Deception. It is also one of the weapons that a player can give to their kreated character in Armageddon. It is also Meat's weapon in Mortal Kombat: Armageddon.

Meat's Cleaver also appears in Mortal Kombat Mobile as an exclusive Equipment Card unlocked in the Tower of Horror. On tag in, the cleaver is thrown for a portion of damage, increases the wearer's Critical Chance.

This bloody, ghastly-looking weapon called Meat's Cleaver (Meat Cleaver) was fashioned from the thighbone of another one of the sorcerer Shang Tsung's failed experiments in his secret flesh pits.
